topic: Sabo's Revolutionary oath survived memory loss, Ace's fall, the loss of Baltigo and a public frame job because it rests on a wound, not on a captain, while every great pirate crew ended with its captain's story
title: Sabo Explained: Why His Oath Outlived Every Pirate Crew
description:
Sabo explained from Gray Terminal to Mary Geoise: why the Revolutionary Army's chief of staff never went back to sea after his memories returned, and why his promise has outlasted the Roger Pirates, the Rocks Pirates, the Whitebeard Pirates and more.

We follow Sabo's whole story in order, chapter by chapter, set it against how each great crew ended, steelman the case against it, and finish with what it means for Luffy, Vivi and the letter of Nefertari D. Lili. Which lasts longer in your view, a crew or a cause?
comment: Is the Revolutionary Army really sturdier than a pirate crew because it has no captain, or is it one fall of Dragon away from ending like every crew did?
